sermon.title: The Father’s Business Venture to Fulfill All Righteousness 04/14/2019
sermon.series: Why Jesus Is Important to All Mankind
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer follows the Father’s business after Jesus was filled with the Spirit: led into the desert, tested by the devil, and returned in power. Testings work patience and show where we are. The early church prayed in unity, spoke with great power, rejoiced in persecution and grew as the word transformed people.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: What kind of church should we be?
faqs.answer: We must decide; small enough to deal with disorder.

faqs.question: How should you see tests?
faqs.answer: As showing your level, not to quit.

faqs.question: Will people always like you?
faqs.answer: No; they feared the early church.

faqs.question: Why spend time with Jesus?
faqs.answer: Instead of believing what we’re told.
